visual.general_description: Six panels from the first case: four laparoscopic operative views (A to D) and two photographs of resected specimens on metal trays (E and F).
visual.detailed_description: Panel A: a roughly square laparoscopic view cropped from a round field. A smooth pink-red rounded structure fills the upper centre. Pale, lobulated, cream-coloured tissue lies on both sides of it, and glossy yellow-orange tissue occupies the lower middle. Thin strands and darker red areas are visible near the left and right edges. The text printed under the image reads "Laparoscopic Exploration". The capital letter A is printed at the upper left. Panel B: a laparoscopic view in which a metal grasping instrument at the upper left and another at the right edge hold a thin, translucent, pale membrane stretched over reddish tissue and yellowish fat. A small pink-red circular structure with a dark centre is at the upper left. Red blood vessels run in the tissue at the lower left. The text printed under the image reads "Anatomic Space Dissection". The capital letter B is printed at the upper left of the panel. Panel C: a laparoscopic view of a pale cream, rough-textured and partly charred-looking area in the centre and lower left, with pinker tissue at the top. A dark grey grasping instrument crosses from the left and a metal instrument comes from the lower left, with a small curled metallic tip near the centre. A rounded pale-yellow lobulated structure lies at the upper right. The text printed under the image reads "Partial Vaginectomy". The capital letter C is printed at the upper left. Panel D: a laparoscopic view of pink-white, rough and blood-stained tissue. A large dark grey instrument crosses from the upper left to the right; text printed along its shaft is partly legible and reads like a manufacturer name followed by "MEDICAL". A small blue perforated object lies beneath the instrument at the centre, and a metal instrument with a flat head is at the lower left. A grasper is at the left edge. The text printed under the image reads "Partial Resection of the Rectum". The capital letter D is printed at the upper left. Panel E: a photograph of a stainless-steel kidney-shaped tray on a teal-green drape. A dark red, irregular, tubular tissue segment with yellow-orange fatty tissue at its upper left lies in the tray, and its lower end shows a ring-like opening. A transparent graduated syringe with blue numbers 10, 8, 6 and 4 on its barrel rests diagonally against the segment, held at the top by a gloved fingertip. A smaller separate dark red tissue fragment lies at the right of the tray. The capital letter E is printed at the upper left of the panel. Panel F: a photograph of a stainless-steel kidney-shaped tray with a folded, glistening pale pink-tan piece of tissue with dark red edges and a ridged surface lying in it. A gloved hand edge is visible at the upper right corner. The capital letter F is printed at the upper left of the panel.

visual.general_description: Four transvaginal ultrasound frames, each showing a dark rounded cavity with a bright structure inside.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A: a fan-shaped greyscale transvaginal ultrasound image on a black background. In the upper left of the sector a small dark rounded cavity with a bright echogenic structure at its lower left lies within a grey, granular, rounded mass. Dark acoustic shadow bands run down the right half. A dark blue header band carries a manufacturer logo, a text field that looks like initials, a hospital-name placeholder, the word "Endo-Vaginal" and a date and time stamp. A depth scale with dots runs down the left edge, system settings are printed at the right edge, and a blue bar with the number sign and three digits is at the lower right. The capital letter A is printed at the upper left. Panel B: a fan-shaped greyscale transvaginal ultrasound image on a black background. A round black cavity with a thin bright rim lies in the upper centre and contains a pale, lumpy echogenic structure. A small dark round spot lies to the right of the cavity, and a dark area occupies the upper right. The header band has the same logo and layout as panel A, with an initials-like field followed by dashes, "HospitalName", "Endo-Vaginal" and a date-time stamp. Depth scale at the left, settings at the right, and a blue bar with a number at the lower right. The capital letter B is printed at the upper left. Panel C: a fan-shaped greyscale transvaginal ultrasound image. A small dark oval cavity with a grey rim lies at the centre within a lighter grey granular area, above a large bright white region. Bright vertical streaks are at the upper right. The header band at the top has a long text string made of digits and the words "ID" and "Name" followed by "HospitalName" and "Endo-Vaginal"; the right side of the header and image is cut off. A depth scale with numbers runs down the left edge. The capital letter C is printed at the upper left. Panel D: a colour-tinted (olive and yellowish) photograph-like capture of a fan-shaped transvaginal ultrasound screen. An irregular black cavity with a pale lumpy echogenic structure at its upper left lies in the upper centre. Dark irregular areas are to the right of it. The screen top shows a manufacturer name, small icons and a percentage text; below it a blue header band has a logo, an initials-like field, "HospitalName", "Endo-Vaginal" and a date-time stamp. Depth scale at the left, settings at the right, and small icons at the lower left. The capital letter D is printed at the upper left.

panels.detailed_description: Panel D: a colour-tinted (olive and yellowish) photograph-like capture of a fan-shaped transvaginal ultrasound screen. An irregular black cavity with a pale lumpy echogenic structure at its upper left lies in the upper centre. Dark irregular areas are to the right of it. The screen top shows a manufacturer name, small icons and a percentage text; below it a blue header band has a logo, an initials-like field, "HospitalName", "Endo-Vaginal" and a date-time stamp. Depth scale at the left, settings at the right, and small icons at the lower left. The capital letter D is printed at the upper left.
